blocks.html: Where a permit is required, as provided in Chapter 1, construction documents shall be required. These documents shall show the dimensions, material and required details of construction, including loads, stresses and anchors. It is the responsibility of the property owner to have every sign for which a permit is required inspected at least once every calendar year.
